run_lint: run pre-commit hooks on all files to lint the pybind11 codebase
run_tests: run the pybind11 test suite using cmake across multiple Python versions
run_packaging_tests: run pytest on the extra_python_package directory to validate packaging
build_docs: build HTML or PDF documentation using Sphinx and optionally serve locally
build_sdist_wheels: build source distributions and wheels including pybind11-global variants
